<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<title>Refinery29</title>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<link rel="icon" href="https://www.refinery29.com/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="title" content="Refinery29 - 404" />

<style class="text/css">
    @font-face {
    font-family: 'Brown Regular';
        src: url('https://web-statics-cdn.refinery29.com/fonts/BrownRegular/brownstd-regular.woff2') format('woff2'),
        url('https://web-statics-cdn.refinery29.com/fonts/BrownRegular/brownstd-regular.woff') format('woff'),
        url('https://web-statics-cdn.refinery29.com/fonts/BrownRegular/brownstd-regular.otf') format('opentype');
    }
    html{
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Roboto", "Oxygen", "Ubuntu", "Cantarell", "Fira Sans", "Droid Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
    }
    body{
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        min-height: 600px;
        margin: 0;
    }
    *{
        -webkit-box-sizing: border-box;
        -moz-box-sizing: border-box;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    a {
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .global-header {
        padding: 0;
        outline: 0;
        font: inherit;
        color: inherit;
        text-align: inherit;
        text-decoration: inherit;
        vertical-align: inherit;
        box-sizing: inherit;
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 280px;
        background: white;
        height: auto;
        margin: 0 auto;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 300;
        border: 0;
    }
    .global-header .global-header-main {
        height: 58px;
        position: relative;
    }
    @media only screen and (min-width: 1221px) {
        .global-header .global-header-main {
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .global-header .global-search-nav {
            max-width: 1100px;
        }
        
    }
    .global-header .global-logo {
        width: 128px;
        height: 100%;
        display: inline-block;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 350;
    }
    .global-header .global-logo .condensed, .global-header .global-logo .full {
        line-height: .6em;
    }
    .global-header .global-logo .full svg {
        width:100%;
        height:59px;
    }
    .global-header .global-logo .condensed, .global-header .global-logo .full {
        line-height: .6em;
    }
    .global-header .global-logo .condensed {
        display: none;
        position: relative;
        height: 58px;
        width: 100%;
        top: -56px;
    }
    .global-header .global-logo .condensed svg{
        width: 100%;
        height: 36px;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation {
        display: inline-block;
        position: absolute;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        left: 0;
        text-align: center;
        z-index: 300;
        display: flex;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories {
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0 auto;
        -webkit-user-select: none;
        -moz-user-select: none;
        -ms-user-select: none;
        user-select: none;
        display: flex;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav {
        font-size: 14px;
        line-height: 1.2em;
        word-spacing: normal;
        font-weight: 400;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .2em;
        color: #fff;
        display: inline-block;
        list-style: none;
        text-align: left;
    }
    .mobile-logos {
        display: none;
        border-top: 1px solid #ddd;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
        padding: 0 15px;
    }
    .mobile-logos .nav-category-and-subnav {
        width: 33%;
        text-align: center;
    }
    .mobile-logos .nav-category-and-subnav img {
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 14px;
    }
    .mobile-logos .nav-category {
        padding: 15px 5px;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav img {
        max-width: 125px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 761px) and (max-width: 1220.98px) {
        .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav img {
            max-width: 100px;
        }
    }
    
    
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav .nav-category {
        padding: 0 15px 0 15px;
        height: 58px;
        position: relative;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav .nav-category.unbothered {
        padding-top: 5px;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav .nav-category.somos {
        padding-top: 4px;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav .nav-category.beautycon {
        padding-top: 2px;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav .nav-category .nav-category-padding {
        position: relative;
        top: 17px;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav.discover:hover .nav-category:before {
        background-color: #ef4b4b;
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        height: 4px;
        width: 100%;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav.discover:hover .nav-category {
        color: #ef4b4b;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav.watch:hover .nav-category:before {
        background-color: #e5059a;
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        height: 4px;
        width: 100%;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav.watch:hover .nav-category {
        color: #e5059a;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav.shop:hover .nav-category:before {
        background-color: #fa9d0d;
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        height: 4px;
        width: 100%;
    }
    .global-header .global-navigation .nav-categories .nav-category-and-subnav.shop:hover .nav-category {
        color: #fa9d0d;
    }
    .global-header .global-edition-switch {
        position: absolute;
        width: 180px;
        top: 22px;
        right: 0px;
        padding: 0 10px;
        text-align: center;
        color: #fff;
        z-index: 350;
        font-size: 0.688rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        font-family: 'Brown Regular', sans-serif;
    }
    .global-header .global-edition-switch .country {
        display: inline-block;
        height: 30px;
        vertical-align: middle;
        color: black;
    }

    .global-header .global-edition-switch .country svg {
        transform: scale(0.25);
        position: absolute;
        top: 9px;
        left: 0;
        transform-origin: top left;
    }

    .global-header .global-edition-switch .country-option {
        display: inline-block;
        width:22px;
        vertical-align: middle;
        margin-right: 6px;
        height:24px;
    }

    .global-header .global-edition-switch .country-option svg{
        width:100%;
        position: relative;
        top: -19px;
    }

    .global-header .global-edition-switch .fa {
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 800;
        height: 12px;
        width: 11px;
        display: inline-block;
        position: relative;
        top: -6px;
        color: black;
    }
    .global-header .global-edition-switch:hover ul, .global-header .global-edition-switch ul:hover {
        visibility: visible;
        opacity: 1;
    }
    .global-header .global-edition-switch ul {
        -webkit-transition: all .1s linear;
        transition: all .1s linear;
        visibility: hidden;
        opacity: 0;
        position: absolute;
        width: 180px;
        padding: 20px;
        left: 0;
        margin: 0 auto;
        background-color: #000;
        color: #fff;
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 1;
    }
    .global-header .global-edition-switch ul li {
        list-style: none;
        margin: 5px 0;
    }
    .global-header .global-edition-switch ul a {
        font-size: 12px;
        letter-spacing: .1em;
        line-height: 1.2em;
        word-spacing: normal;
        font-weight: 400;
        color: #fff;
    }
    .global-header .global-edition-switch ul a img {
        height: 12px;
        margin-right: 5px;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav {
        display: block;
        margin: auto;
        top: -58px;
        right: 0;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 350;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav.active {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background-color: #fff;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 375;
        max-width: 100%;
        top: 0;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav .search-drawer .search-close {
        display: none;
        position: absolute;
        top: 8px;
        right: 0;
        cursor: pointer;
        height: 44px;
        width: 44px;
        color: #000;
        border: none;
        background: none;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav.active .search-drawer, .global-header .global-search-nav.active .search-drawer #search-header, .global-header .global-search-nav.active .search-drawer .search-close {
        display: inline-block;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav.active .search-drawer, .global-header .global-search-nav.active .search-drawer #search-header, .global-header .global-search-nav.active .search-drawer .search-close {
        display: inline-block;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav .search-button {
        position: absolute;
        margin: auto;
        top: 0;
        right: 0;
        height: 50%;
        width: 20px;
        z-index: 375;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav .search-button .fa-search {
        position: absolute;
        top: 17px;
        right: 0;
        font-size: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        color: black;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav.active .search-button .fa-search {
        display: none;
    }
    .fa, .fa svg {
        display: inline-block;
    }
    #email-acquisition-submit-done .fa{
        height: 18px;
        width: 18px;
        overflow: inherit;
    }
    .global-header .global-edition-switch .label {
        opacity: 0.75;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav .search-drawer {
        display: none;
        position: absolute;
        margin: auto;
        top: 0;
        right: 0;
        left: 0;
        height: 100%;
        max-width: 1100px;
        background: #fff;
        z-index: 375;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav .search-drawer form {
        height: 100%;
        width: 100%;
    }
    .global-header .global-search-nav .search-drawer #search-header {
        font-size: 22px;
        word-spacing: normal;
        letter-spacing: -.02em;
        line-height: 1.3em;
        text-transform: none;
        font-weight: 400;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        color: #000;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0 50px;
        text-align: center;
        border: 0;
        outline: none;
        box-shadow: none;
    }
    .error-wrapper{
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 500px;
        height: 100vh;
        max-height: 700px;
        overflow: hidden;
        z-index: 1;
        font-size: 0;
        text-align: center;
        background-image: url('https://www.refinery29.com/images/9008667.jpg?auto=webp&quality=50');
        background-size: cover;
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        background-position: center center;
        background-color: #999;
    }
    .error-wrapper:before{
        content: '';
        display: inline-block;
        vertical-align: middle;
        height: 100%;
        margin-left: -0.25em;
    }
    .error-wrapper:after{
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        z-index: 2;
        opacity: 0.6;
        background-color: #4c3c69;
    }
    .error-wrapper .errortext{
        display: inline-block;
        position: relative;
        font-size: 24px;
        letter-spacing: 0.025em;
        line-height: 1.4em;
        color: #ffffff;
        max-width: 800px;
        vertical-align: middle;
        z-index: 10;
        padding: 60px 30px 0 30px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 320px){
        .error-wrapper .errortext{
            padding: 0 30px 0 30px;
            bottom: 15px;
        }
    }
    .error-wrapper .errortext h1{
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        font-weight: normal;
        font-size: 60px;
        line-height: 1.2em;
    }
    .error-wrapper .errortext p{
        margin: 20px;
        padding: 0;
    }
    @media (max-width: 800px){
        .error-wrapper .errortext{
            font-size: 18px;
        }
        .error-wrapper .errortext h1{
            font-size: 46px;
        }
        .error-wrapper .errortext p{
            margin: 15px;
            padding: 0;
        }
    }
    @media (max-width: 500px){
        .error-wrapper .errortext{
            font-size: 16px;
        }
        .error-wrapper .errortext h1{
            font-size: 32px;
        }
        .error-wrapper .errortext p{
            margin: 10px;
            padding: 0;
        }
    }
    .error-wrapper .errortext button{
        font-size: 11px;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        word-spacing: normal;
        font-weight: bold;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        display: block;
        margin: 40px auto;
        padding: 0 30px;
        height: 40px;
        line-height: 38px;
        border-radius: 20px;
        border: 2px solid #ffffff;
        color: #ffffff;
        background-color: transparent;
        outline: none;
        transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out,
                    color 0.2s ease-in-out;
        -webkit-transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out,
                    color 0.2s ease-in-out;
        -moz-transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out,
                    color 0.2s ease-in-out;
        -o-transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out,
                    color 0.2s ease-in-out;
    }
    @media (max-width: 320px){
        .error-wrapper .errortext button{
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
    }
    .error-wrapper .errortext button:hover{
        background-color: #ffffff;
        color: #333;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    .global-footer {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        padding-top: 60px;
        padding-bottom: 60px;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.05);
        background-color: #fff;
        max-width: 1800px;
        text-align: center;
        margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .global-footer .social-container {
        position: relative;
        display: inline-block;
        vertical-align: top;
        margin-right: 75px;
    }
    .global-footer .social-container .logo {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        width: 122px;
        height: 78px;
        margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .global-footer .social-container .copyright {
        font-size: 13px;
        letter-spacing: .1em;
        line-height: 1.2em;
        word-spacing: normal;
        font-weight: 400;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #787679;
        text-align: center;
        margin: 10px auto 0;
    }
    .global-footer .social-container .social-nav {
        list-style: none;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 20px auto 0;
